name: a-part-of-a-template-reads-a-name-the-code-of-map-declared

name: a-second-declaration-is-the-step-that-failed
query: ~(:k 1; :k 2; k) | answer !| trace | first | failed

name: a-recipe-declares-no-input-of-its-verb-again
query: :number/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~(:x 3; add x)); 1 | m 2 !| get [~(tag) ~(name)]

name: a-recipe-of-one-step-declares-no-input-again
query: :number/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~(:x 3;)); 1 | m 2 !| get [~(tag) ~(name)]

name: a-recipe-declares-no-args-of-its-call-again

name: a-group-in-a-recipe-shadows-an-input-as-any-scope-of-its-own

name: a-recipe-declares-a-name-its-call-binds-not

name: a-later-step-of-a-recipe-declares-no-input-again
query: :number/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~(:x 3; add 1 | add x)); 1 | m 2 !| get [~(tag) ~(name)]

name: a-recipe-declares-no-input-its-call-leaves-to-the-default
query: :number/plus (::fn | takes :by |~~ The by. ~~| ~(query /0 1) | impl ~(:by 3; add by)); 5 | plus !| get [~(tag) ~(name)]

name: a-quote-a-recipe-runs-declares-an-input-in-its-own-scope
query: :vec/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~(map ~(:x 3; add x))); [1 2] | m 5

name: a-recipe-of-one-group-declares-an-input-in-the-group-s-scope
query: :number/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~((:x 3; x))); 1 | m 2

name: a-group-opens-a-scope-of-its-own
query: apply ~(:k 1; (:k 2; k))

name: an-element-opens-a-scope-of-its-own
query: apply ~(:k 1; get [~(:k 2; k) ~(k)])

name: a-helper-in-a-group-closes-with-it
query: apply ~(:f (:h 2; ~(mul h)); ::host | env | has :h)

name: a-recipe-names-a-value-derived-from-an-input
query: :vec/m (::fn | takes :k |~~ The k. ~~| /0 ::number | impl ~(:limit (k | mul 2); take limit)); [1 2 3 4 5] | m 2

name: a-recipe-shadows-a-name-of-its-scope
query: apply ~(:n 1; :any/f (::fn | takes :n |~~ The n. ~~| ~(query /0 2) ::number | impl ~(n)); null | get [~(f) ~(n)])

name: a-name-declared-in-a-recipe-stays-inside-it
query: :number/f (::fn | takes :n |~~ The n. ~~| /0 | impl ~(n | with {:captured ~it} ~(captured | add n))); get [~(0 | f 3) ~(::host | env | has :captured)]

name: code-a-verb-runs-names-a-value-in-its-steps
query: [1 2 3] | filter ~(:n 2; gt n)

name: a-name-at-a-node-the-chain-of-its-noun-laid-is-declared-twice
query: ~(:Box |~~ A box. ~~| (::kind | accepts |~~ The facts. ~~| ::map | wires :w |~~ The width. ~~| /w ::number); :Box/w ~(2)) | answer !| get [~(tag) ~(name)]

name: a-name-at-the-page-of-the-payload-of-a-kind-is-declared-twice
query: ~(:Box |~~ A box. ~~| (::kind | accepts |~~ The facts. ~~| ::map | wires :w |~~ The width. ~~| /w ::number); :Box/payload ~(1)) | answer !| get [~(tag) ~(name)]

name: a-name-at-an-input-the-chain-of-a-function-laid-is-declared-twice
query: ~(:number/f (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0); :number/f/x |~~ Another page. ~~|) | answer !| get [~(tag) ~(name)]

name: a-name-beside-the-nodes-of-a-chain-and-one-in-a-group-stand
query: :Box |~~ A box. ~~| (::kind | accepts |~~ The facts. ~~| ::map | wires :w |~~ The width. ~~| /w ::number); :Box/area ~(w | mul 2); get [~(::Box{:w 3} | area) ~(:Box/w ~(2); ::Box{:w 3} | w)]

name: a-name-a-step-declared-around-stands-again-in-a-group-that-declares-its-noun
query: :Box |~~ A box. ~~|; :Box/area ~(1); (:Box |~~ Another box. ~~| (::kind | wires :w |~~ The width. ~~| /w ::number); :Box/area ~(w | mul 2); ::Box{:w 3} | area)

name: a-failed-declaration-flies-past-the-tail-of-its-text-to-the-step-that-runs-it
query: ~(:Box |~~ A box. ~~|; :Box |~~ A crate. ~~|; 1 !| 0) | answer !| tag
